overview.title: Program Overview
overview.description: Train for a career as a Dental Assistant in as little as nine months with PCI’s Hybrid Dental Assistant Program. The program combines flexible online coursework with limited on-campus lab sessions where you’ll learn chairside assisting, radiology, clinical procedures, and administrative tasks so you can work in a dental office.

faq.question: How long does the Hybrid Dental Assistant program take to complete?
faq.answer: The program can prepare you for a career as a Dental Assistant in as little as nine months.

faq.question: Where is the Dental Assistant Hybrid program offered?
faq.answer: Dental Assistant training for the hybrid program is offered at PCI Health Training Center’s Richardson campus (Northeast Dallas).

faq.question: Does the program include hands-on training and externship?
faq.answer: Yes. The hybrid program includes in-person lab sessions and an off-site externship at a dental office for real-world experience.

faq.question: Does the program prepare me for certification or licensure?
faq.answer: PCI’s Dental Assistant program prepares graduates for the Dental Assistant Examination to become a Registered Dental Assistant in the State of Texas.
